blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats and waverunners to explore Navarre Beach waters, participate in guided dolphin excursions, enjoy a ropes course and zip line, or have fun on a Wibit Waterpark obstacle course. Rentals include fuel, life jackets, and insurance. The facility operates year-round with various activity options and bundles.
